description: This file contains the PHP class 'CustomerTransaction' which is a model extending the system engine model. It includes methods for retrieving transaction data and transaction totals related to customers, filtered by date ranges and other criteria.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Model class for handling customer transaction report data. Provides methods to fetch transaction list and total count with filtering options.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions based on provided filters such as date range and customer name, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of unique customers with transactions matching the specified filters.
